diagnosis: The route enforces OAuth2 scopes using Security(get_current_active_user, scopes=['orders:read']), verifying the access token has permission to read orders. However, the handler looks up the order solely by order_id without ensuring order.customer_id == user.customer_id. Possession of the scope permits an application to read any customer's orders across the platform.
exploit_request:
GET /orders/99241 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <oauth_token_with_orders_read_scope>
